card.name: Numbers in dose adjustment instructions
card.fires_on: Numbers and small words inside dose-adjustment instructions, such as a capped BSA or weight value, a raised dose, or a reduced frequency like once daily.

modes.label: Digits of a target value
modes.description: A digit within a dose, BSA, or grade value that the instruction sets as the new or capped figure.

modes.label: Linking word before the adjusted amount
modes.description: A small word such as of, once, or and right before the new frequency, weight, or companion drug.
